sections.name: Nordmann six-slide carousel component
owners: unique __AF_SOURCE_INTERACTIONS_V001__ database marker found under Head & Footer Code option auhfc_settings_sitewide
source_runtime_truth: manual is initialized once from carousel--manual and never reassigned.
Successful navigation on a non-manual instance calls go() then start(), resetting/restarting the ~4000ms interval.

drop() removes slide/dot and reindexes. At zero remaining slides it calls stop(), hides the nearest project-card__extra/hero-proof owner or carousel and returns. At exactly one remaining slide it calls stop() because slides.length<2, then go(). At two or more remaining slides it neither stops nor restarts solely because of removal.
sections.proof_only: Exact deployed Head & Footer Code option identity plus synchronized action/timing proof.
